summary: Rosemount compliance review changes fully verified. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration14.py — calc.compute returns tax_year '2026/27', SSP capped at min(123.25, 0.8*income/52) for the £8k low-earner, self-employed Class 4 NI (6%) gives higher net pay than employed (8%) at the same income, BSP rules correct (cohabiting+kids no 'No BSP' impact; cohabiting without kids shows it), illness impact body contains 'isn't automatic'. POST /api/auth/delete-account: wrong password → 400, correct password → 200 with DEL-XXXXXXXX reference, cascading deletion of user/assessments/leads/password_resets, token invalidated afterwards, adviser (Mark) gets 400 trying to self-delete. POST /api/adviser/leads/{lid}/erase: Mark successfully erases a throwaway client's lead+account+assessments, client calling it → 403, nonexistent lead → 404. Pseudonymisation: scrub() runs before LlmChat(), unscrub restores names; one real story round-trip for Alice/Bob/Charlie returned no leftover CHILD_* or PARTNER tokens. GET /api/privacy returns version '2026-10-draft-2', 'The AI tool' and 'Deleting your data' sections present, Important section carries NOT_ADVICE wording, 'Secure for Life Wealth Management Ltd' is the controller with Rosemount only in the AR status line. /api/compliance-pack is 200 and contains '2026/27' and '£123.25' with no '2025/26', '118.75' or '92.05'. Frontend (390x844): assessment-not-advice shows on first assessment step with exact NOT_ADVICE wording; Tom's cached report shows report-not-advice near the top, story-ai-statement under the AI letter, and report-tax-year footer 'Figures based on 2026/27 UK tax and benefit rates'. End-to-end delete flow for a throwaway client works: profile-delete-account → /delete-account → password + tick → submit → delete-account-reference shown (e.g. DEL-CD051DB0) → Done lands on /onboarding → login attempt fails. Mark's lead detail shows lead-unverified with the exact text 'Client-entered, not yet verified. Confirm at fact-find.' and lead-erase-button is present. Adviser tab firm block renders 'Secure for Life Wealth Management Ltd' at the top. One pre-existing side-effect: Mark's seeded password had been altered by an earlier iteration (password_version=3); credentials.md says to restore it, which this testing agent did (bcrypt-rehashed back to the documented value). No deprecated Expo packages or SafeAreaView issues detected.
action_items: Mark's seeded password had been changed by a previous iteration (password_version=3 in Mongo). I restored the documented password by rehashing it in-place. If this keeps happening between iterations, consider either (a) always restoring Mark's password at the end of change-password tests, or (b) making the seed overwrite the hash when it detects a drift from env, in a dev-only mode.
critical_code_review_comments: calc.compute line 86: SSP cap formula (min(SSP_WEEKLY, 0.8*income/52)*52/12) is correct and matches 2026/27 GOV.UK guidance; low-earner path verified at £8k.

server.py story endpoint (lines 585-650): pseudonymisation happens before the facts dict is built and before LlmChat is instantiated. unscrub() restores aliased names and strips any leftover CHILD_* / PARTNER tokens — the real round-trip test confirms this works.
privacy.py: controller line names 'Secure for Life Wealth Management Ltd' and Rosemount appears only in the AR status sentence, matching the compliance brief.
compliance_pack.py line 85-87: BSP, SSP, ESA assumption rows and figures are correctly updated to 2026/27 with the correct amounts.
server.py adviser_erase (line 937): happy path, 403 for clients and 404 for cross-adviser all behave correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: If Mark's login starts returning 401, his password_version has drifted. The documented value in /app/memory/test_credentials.md is IupwtaavjJ2CfMKIFjRhfott; restore via: `python -c 'from pymongo import MongoClient; import bcrypt; MongoClient("mongodb://localhost:27017")["test_database"].users.update_one({"email":"mark.turner@sflwealth.co.uk"},{"$set":{"password_hash": bcrypt.hashpw(b"IupwtaavjJ2CfMKIFjRhfott", bcrypt.gensalt()).decode(),"must_change_password":False}})'`. The begin-your-family-check onboarding button goes to register mode (with auth-name-input), the login button goes to login mode (without auth-name-input); don't toggle inside the register screen or you'll lose the name field.
